thread:
rachel: Quick cup census  who has a mug living at the office? Also proposing a scone truce: if you bring sweets, also bring one savory.
tom: I have a mug on the top shelf. truce sounds fair.
jo: I'm allergic to tree nuts  can we please label any pastry with allergens?
adil: Small PSA: dishwasher detergent is out. someone touched the last pod.
kitchen-bot: Inventory alert: dishwasher detergent 0 pods, ground coffee 1. Suggested action: restock detergent within 48h. react :warning:
andrew: I can pick up detergent and scones on my way back at ~3:20. Any flavor vetoes?
rachel: No nuts for jo please. Also sticker idea: "mug owner" label on shelf to avoid the mug graveyard.
tom: I'll bring a sheet of pre-cut stickers and a Sharpie.
jo: Thanks all. I'll add an allergen sticky to any pastry I bring in future.
adil: Dishwasher loaded by adil at 12:05 and started. Leaving a sticky: "Done  adil" (will check later).
kitchen-bot: Action logged: restock request for detergent submitted. react :white_check_mark:
andrew: Back with scones and detergent. Bought 6 scones: 3 blueberry (nut-free), 3 cheddar-herb (contains dairy). Detergent pod pack on the shelf. Left a note labeling allergens.
rachel: Scone hero! Leaving one for the morning crew. Also adding "mug label" template to the fridge.
tom: Sticker kit deployed on the top shelf. Please write initials.
jo: Eating one now  thank you andrew, and thanks everyone for labeling. Means a lot.
adil: Detergent restocked  dishwasher happy. Small reminder: rinse before loading.
kitchen-bot: Inventory update: dishwasher detergent restocked, ground coffee 1 bag remaining. react :coffee:
rachel: Truce successful. Adding tiny rule: "If you take the last of consumable, please replace or add $1 to the jar." Peaceful pantry achieved. :peace_symbol:
